create_quantization_recipe: create an FP8 quantization recipe using QuantizationModifier with per-channel weights and dynamic per-token activations
run_oneshot_quantization: run oneshot quantization on a HuggingFace causal language model with a QuantizationModifier recipe
load_model_pretrained: load a HuggingFace AutoModelForCausalLM and AutoTokenizer from a pretrained model ID
dispatch_model_offload: dispatch a model for CPU offloading using compressed_tensors dispatch_model
save_quantized_model: save a quantized model and tokenizer to disk in compressed-tensors format with save_pretrained
